segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, I'm Dr. Tan from the anesthesia team. I'll be taking care of you during your surgery today. Let me go through some questions to make sure we're all set for your laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Morning, Doctor. I'm ready when you are.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Great. Can you tell me a bit about why you're having this surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Sure. I've been having pain on my right side, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, and the doctor said it's best to remove the gallbladder laparoscopically.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Understood. Now, let's go through your medical history. You have high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and anxiety, right?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, lah. Been on meds for all of them for years now.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: What medications are you currently taking?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Amlodipine once daily for BP, Atorvastatin at night for cholesterol, Sertraline for anxiety. Oh, and I used to take Omeprazole for acid reflux, but I stopped that three months ago when the symptoms went away.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thanks for mentioning that. Let me check your records... it says here you're still on Omeprazole. Can you confirm if you're still taking all the medications listed here?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, Doctor. Like I said, I stopped the Omeprazole three months back. My GERD got better, so I didn't need it anymore. The rest are still going strong, though.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Appreciate the clarification. Any allergies to medications or other substances?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: None that I know of, Doctor.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, this is my first time. Never been under general anesthesia before.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright. How about your fasting status? When was your last meal or drink?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I stopped eating from midnight last night, as instructed. Just had a sip of water with my morning meds around 6 AM.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Perfect. Finally, how's your overall energy and mobility? Can you walk or climb stairs without issues?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yeah, no problems there. I walk 20 minutes most days and can climb stairs without getting short of breath.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Excellent. We'll be using general anesthesia with an LMA and sevoflurane for your surgery. Any questions for me?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, Doctor. You've explained everything clearly. I'm ready to proceed.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Great. We'll get you set up shortly. Take a deep breath and relax – we've got you covered.
